POSTGRES_USER.description: Postgres superuser name. Also used by Paperless-ngx to connect (PGUSER).

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Postgres password. Also used by Paperless-ngx to connect (PGPASSWORD). Default literal 'paperless' so a fresh template deploy authenticates out of the box. Rotate this in the dashboard before production.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial database created on first boot. Must match PAPERLESS_DBNAME on the Paperless service.

PGDATA.description: Postgres data directory. Must be a subdirectory of the volume mount path (/var/lib/postgresql) so lost+found stays outside PGDATA.

PGHOST.description: Postgres internal hostname. Shared with the Paperless-ngx service via companion-mapping.

PGPORT.description: Postgres port. Shared with the Paperless-ngx service via companion-mapping.

PGUSER.description: Postgres username for Paperless-ngx. Shared with the Paperless-ngx service via companion-mapping.

PGPASSWORD.description: Postgres password for Paperless-ngx. Shared with the Paperless-ngx service via companion-mapping. Must match POSTGRES_PASSWORD.
